root_causes.description: The email deployment's container is repeatedly restarting in a crash loop. Kubernetes reported repeated container restarts ('Container email definition changed, will be restarted') and a back-off restarting the failing email container, confirming a pod_crash fault localized to email, a leaf service downstream of checkout.

evidence.query_or_id: BackOff: Back-off restarting failed container email in pod email-7699887dd9-rnbxw_otel-demo(c9cf2589-71fd-45ed-bb7c-39ada7acd0a9) (count=5)
evidence.observed_value: count=5 back-off restarts of container email in the window
evidence.expected_baseline: 0 restart back-offs for a healthy service

evidence.query_or_id: Killing: Container email definition changed, will be restarted (count=2)
evidence.expected_baseline: no container kills during steady state

root_causes.description: Email pod working-set memory shows a bimodal distribution (mean 63MB, p50 41MB, p95/max ~154MB), which could indicate memory pressure driving the container restarts, though the summary flagged no formal anomaly.

evidence.expected_baseline: stable working set near p50 (~40MB); no 3.8x spikes

root_causes.description: As the immediate upstream caller of email, checkout could surface failures when email becomes unavailable during its crash loop; however no elevated error rate or restarts were observed on checkout, so this is a possible secondary effect rather than the root cause.

evidence.expected_baseline: 0 restarts expected; confirms checkout itself is stable

evidence.observed_value: max=0.000 error rate captured on email SERVER spans

remediation_steps: Inspect the email pod (email-7699887dd9-rnbxw) describe output and container exit codes to determine why the container keeps crashing.
Review the email container spec/ConfigMap for the 'definition changed' trigger and roll back the recent change that forced the container restart.
Check the failing image pull for the sandbox pause image (ErrImagePull/ImagePullBackOff) and restore registry access so the pod sandbox can start reliably.
Verify/raise memory limits on the email container if memory pressure is confirmed, and monitor working-set memory after rollout.
